title: OMRP-CS150 Standard Close-Coupled Centrifugal Pump
name: OMRP-CS150 STANDARD CLOSE-COUPLED CENTRIFUGAL PUMP
description:
Application
• Circulation and transfer of clean, chemically non­aggressive water and other liquids
• Water supply & irrigation 
• Water circulation in air conditioning systems
fullContent:
OMRP-CS150 Standard Centrifugal Pump

Compliance with EN733 (DIN24255) standard.

OMRP-CS150 pumps are designed to pump clean liquid, without solid particles or fibers, which are non-aggressive chemically to the pump material.

Application

  • Water supply and drainage
  • HVAC and cooling tower
  • Marine-Ballasting & Bilge
  • Booster and pressurization set
  • Irrigation and agriculture
  • Food and chemical industry (with stainless steel material)

Features

  • Back-pull-out design: Allows maintenance without removing the pump body from the pipework.
  • Performance: High efficiency and wide performance range.
  • Standard motor: High-quality standard motor.

Operating Conditions

  • Delivery: up to 220 m³/h
  • Head: up to 95 m
  • Liquid temperature: -10°C to +85°C (optional up to 120°C)
  • Max. working pressure: 12 bar (PN12)
  • Impeller: HT200 (standard), AISI 304/316 (optional)
  • Mechanical Seal: DIN 24960 standard
  • Flange: EN 1092-2 (Standard), ISO 7005-2 (Optional)
